coreOverlap: Unmeasured; no incremental benefit is claimed.
protectedReasoning: Eight clients fail once together at logical time zero. Exactly one retry each is permitted. In the injected deterministic schedule no logical slot may contain more than two retry starts; initial attempts are outside that retry-slot allowance.

The explicit caller/adapter configuration makes the declared protection checkable from visible inputs: The eight callers use unique indices 0 through 7 and share one `ManualClock` instance. This reproduction begins after one scripted failed initial attempt per client, at common logical time zero. Every retry is scheduled before the clock advances. The supplied `start` callback synchronously records the clock value at each start; it neither creates pending asynchronous work nor performs external admission. No other controller reschedules or rate-limits these starts. These index and callback facts are supplied configuration, not properties guaranteed by the local retry helper for arbitrary callers.
Protection applies to this declared path and schedule, not arbitrary production workloads.
